blocks.explanation:
Yeh do \(3 \times 3\) matrices ke minus (subtraction) ka seedha sawal hai.
Diya kya hai? \(A\) aur \(B\), dono \(3 \times 3\).
Find kya karna hai? Matrix \(A - B\).
Rule kaunsa? Same order ki matrices mein har entry apni hi jagah wali entry se minus hoti hai.
Plan: order check, har jagah ka minus brackets ke saath, phir \(B\) wapas jama kar ke tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(A\) aur \(B\) (upar sawal mein), dono ka order \(3 \times 3\).
Humein find karna hai: \(A - B\).
Tareeqa: Same order ki do matrices ko entry by entry minus kiya jata hai: \(A - B\) ki row \(i\), column \(j\) wali entry \(a_{ij} - b_{ij}\) hoti hai. Order same hona zaroori hai, warna kisi entry ka jora hi nahi milega; yahan dono \(3 \times 3\) hain, is liye kaam ho sakta hai.

Har entry apni jagah wali entry se minus karein
\[A - B = \begin{bmatrix}0 - 2 & -1 - 1 & 2 - (-1) \\ 3 - 1 & 2 - 2 & 1 - 4 \\ -1 - (-1) & 0 - 2 & 4 - 1\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: Pehle saare minus ek hi matrix mein likh lena achhi aadat hai, taake koi jagah na chhoote. \(B\) ki negative entries ko bracket mein likha, jaise \(2 - (-1)\), kyunke minus ke baad minus aaye to sign badal kar plus ho jata hai, aur bracket ke baghair yeh aksar nazar se reh jata hai.
Dhyan dein: Sab se aam ghalti \(2 - (-1) = 1\) likhna hai; sahi jawab 3 hai.

Tasdeeq: \(B\) wapas jama karein
\[B + (A - B) = A\]
\[\text{Row 1: } (2 - 2,\ 1 - 2,\ -1 + 3)\]
\[= (0,\ -1,\ 2) \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Agar \(A - B\) sahi hai to us mein \(B\) jama karne se \(A\) wapas milna chahiye, bilkul jaise \(7 - 3 = 4\) aur \(3 + 4 = 7\). Pehli row \(A\) ki pehli row \((0, -1, 2)\) ban gayi; baaqi rows bhi isi tarah check kar lijiye.

blocks.explanation:
Phir se do \(3 \times 3\) matrices ka minus, is dafa \(B\) mein se \(C\).
Diya kya hai? \(B\) aur \(C\), dono \(3 \times 3\).
Find kya karna hai? \(B - C\).
Rule kaunsa? Entry by entry subtraction.
Plan: brackets ke saath minus, signs par khaas tawajjoh, phir \(C\) jama kar ke tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(B\) aur \(C\) (upar sawal mein), dono ka order \(3 \times 3\).
Humein find karna hai: \(B - C\).
Tareeqa: Har jagah \(b_{ij} - c_{ij}\). Is matrix \(C\) mein kai negative entries hain (\(-2\), \(-1\), \(-1\)), is liye yahan signs ki ghalti ka khatra zyada hai; hum har negative entry ko bracket mein likhenge.

Har entry apni jagah wali entry se minus karein
\[B - C = \begin{bmatrix}2 - 1 & 1 - 0 & -1 - (-2) \\ 1 - (-1) & 2 - 5 & 4 - 0 \\ -1 - 3 & 2 - 4 & 1 - (-1)\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: Sirf same position wali entries ka minus hota hai: pehli row pehli row se, aur us mein pehla column pehle column se. Brackets is liye ke minus ke baad negative number aaye to dono minus mil kar plus ban jate hain.

Hisaab kar ke saaf likhein
\[B - C = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 1 & 1 \\ 2 & -3 & 4 \\ -4 & -2 & 2\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: Mushkil wali entries: \(-1 - (-2) = -1 + 2 = 1\), \(1 - (-1) = 1 + 1 = 2\), aur \(1 - (-1) = 2\). Baaqi seedhi hain: \(2 - 1 = 1\), \(1 - 0 = 1\), \(2 - 5 = -3\), \(4 - 0 = 4\), \(-1 - 3 = -4\), \(2 - 4 = -2\).
Dhyan dein: \(-1 - 3\) ko \(2\) ya \(-2\) likhna aam ghalti hai; negative mein se aur minus karein to number aur negative hota hai: \(-4\).

Tasdeeq: \(C\) wapas jama karein
\[C + (B - C) = B\]
\[\text{Row 3: } (3 - 4,\ 4 - 2,\ -1 + 2)\]
\[= (-1,\ 2,\ 1) \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(C\) ki teesri row \((3, 4, -1)\) mein jawab ki teesri row \((-4, -2, 2)\) jama ki to \(B\) ki teesri row \((-1, 2, 1)\) wapas mil gayi. Baaqi rows bhi isi tarah milti hain, is liye jawab sahi hai.

blocks.explanation:
Bracket batata hai ke kaam ki tarteeb kya hai: pehle \(A - B\), phir us mein se \(C\).
Diya kya hai? \(A - B\) hum part (i) mein nikal chuke hain, aur \(C\) di hui hai.
Find kya karna hai? \((A - B) - C\).
Rule kaunsa? Pehle bracket, phir entry by entry subtraction.
Plan: part (i) ka jawab uthayein, \(C\) minus karein, aur ek row ko doosre tareeqe se check karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: part (i) se \(A - B\), aur matrix \(C\).
Humein find karna hai: \((A - B) - C\).
Tareeqa: Jaise numbers mein \((8 - 3) - 2\) mein pehle bracket hal karte hain, waise hi yahan pehle \(A - B\) (jo part (i) mein mil chuka hai), phir us mein se \(C\) entry by entry minus.

Part (i) ka jawab istemal karein
\[A - B = \begin{bmatrix}-2 & -2 & 3 \\ 2 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & -2 & 3\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: Jo kaam ho chuka hai usay dobara karne ki zaroorat nahi; exam mein bhi pichle part ka jawab use karna jaaiz hai aur waqt bachata hai. Bas yaqeen kar lein ke pichla jawab check kiya hua ho.

\(C\) ko entry by entry minus karein
\[(A - B) - C = \begin{bmatrix}-2 - 1 & -2 - 0 & 3 - (-2) \\ 2 - (-1) & 0 - 5 & -3 - 0 \\ 0 - 3 & -2 - 4 & 3 - (-1)\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: Har jagah \((A - B)\) ki entry mein se \(C\) ki usi jagah wali entry minus ki. \(C\) ki negative entries \(-2\) aur \(-1\) bracket mein hain taake sign na bigre.

Tasdeeq: pehli row doosre tareeqe se
\[a_{1j} - b_{1j} - c_{1j}\]
\[(0 - 2 - 1,\ -1 - 1 - 0,\ 2 + 1 + 2)\]
\[= (-3,\ -2,\ 5) \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Is dafa part (i) ka sahara liye baghair seedha \(A\), \(B\), \(C\) ki pehli rows se hisaab kiya: \(2 - (-1) - (-2) = 2 + 1 + 2 = 5\). Wohi pehli row mili, is liye jawab par bharosa hai.

blocks.explanation:
Is dafa bracket \(B - C\) ke gird hai: pehle \(B - C\), phir usay \(A\) mein se minus karna hai.
Diya kya hai? \(A\), aur \(B - C\) jo part (ii) mein mil chuka hai.
Find kya karna hai? \(A - (B - C)\).
Rule kaunsa? Pehle bracket, phir entry by entry subtraction.
Plan: part (ii) ka jawab, \(A\) mein se minus, tasdeeq, aur aakhir mein part (iii) se muqabla.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(A\), aur part (ii) se \(B - C\).
Humein find karna hai: \(A - (B - C)\).
Tareeqa: Pehle bracket wala kaam (part (ii) mein ho chuka), phir \(A\) ki har entry mein se \(B - C\) ki usi jagah wali entry minus. Yeh sawal dekhne mein part (iii) jaisa hai, lekin bracket ki jagah badal gayi hai; aakhir mein dekhenge ke is se jawab badalta hai ya nahi.

Part (ii) ka jawab istemal karein
\[B - C = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 1 & 1 \\ 2 & -3 & 4 \\ -4 & -2 & 2\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: Bracket ke andar ka kaam pehle hota hai, aur woh hum part (ii) mein check kar ke kar chuke hain, is liye seedha use kar liya.

\(A\) mein se entry by entry minus karein
\[A - (B - C) = \begin{bmatrix}0 - 1 & -1 - 1 & 2 - 1 \\ 3 - 2 & 2 - (-3) & 1 - 4 \\ -1 - (-4) & 0 - (-2) & 4 - 2\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(B - C\) ab ek hi matrix hai; us ki har entry ko \(A\) ki usi jagah wali entry mein se minus kiya. Negative entries \(-3\), \(-4\), \(-2\) bracket mein hain.

Tasdeeq: \(A - (B - C) = (A - B) + C\)
\[\text{Row 1: } (-2 + 1,\ -2 + 0,\ 3 - 2)\]
\[= (-1,\ -2,\ 1) \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Bracket kholte waqt bracket se pehle wala minus andar ke har sign ko badal deta hai: \(-(B - C) = -B + C\). Is liye jawab \((A - B) + C\) ke barabar hona chahiye. Part (i) ki pehli row \((-2, -2, 3)\) mein \(C\) ki pehli row \((1, 0, -2)\) jama ki to wohi \((-1, -2, 1)\) mila.

Part (iii) se muqabla karein
\[(A - B) - C \neq A - (B - C)\]
Kyun: Part (iii) aur (iv) ke jawab mukhtalif hain; dono ka farq \(2C\) hai, kyunke ek mein \(C\) minus hua aur doosre mein plus. Numbers mein bhi \((8 - 3) - 2 = 3\) lekin \(8 - (3 - 2) = 7\). Yani subtraction associative nahi: bracket kahan lagi hai, is se farq parta hai.
Dhyan dein: Bracket ko nazarandaaz kar ke dono ko ek jaisa samajhna aam ghalti hai.
